| before — base `86652640`, `en` | ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yuanzhou75/sciencediscovery/f14b925e39a094ad4505320e9eec24eddd7c86ec/screenshots/1532/desktop-session-before-en.png) |

Panel close-ups: [before](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yuanzhou75/sciencediscovery/3f3ae3da2a298abf592d40d16ae36cefdcab805d/screenshots/1532/desktop-panel-before-zh-CN.png) · [after](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yuanzhou75/sciencediscovery/3f3ae3da2a298abf592d40d16ae36cefdcab805d/screenshots/1532/desktop-panel-after-zh-CN.png) — English: [before](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yuanzhou75/sciencediscovery/f14b925e39a094ad4505320e9eec24eddd7c86ec/screenshots/1532/desktop-panel-before-en.png) · [after](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yuanzhou75/sciencediscovery/f14b925e39a094ad4505320e9eec24eddd7c86ec/screenshots/1532/desktop-panel-after-en.png)

Harness: the repository's own desktop e2e config (`apps/desktop/e2e`, `installMockApi` + vite on 4175), one snapshot — `{ role: "imported_snapshot", state: "ready", continuationAvailable: true, continuationDowngraded: true, missingImmutableEvidence: [cas:…, version:…] }` — 1280×800, DPR 1, captured twice — once with `sciencediscovery-desktop:locale` at `zh-CN` and once at `en`, so the English copy added in `apps/desktop/src/text/en.ts` has frames of its own. The before frame is the base commit's source in the same harness (only `apps/desktop` stashed), not a mock of the new state.

What the pair is judged by, sampled from the DOM in both runs: `alertCount` 0 → 1; the `li` list goes from empty to exactly the two declared items; the panel gains `部分证据缺失，结果不可复现…` and `此副本缺少的不可变证据：`; the button stays `disabled: false` in both, and its width goes 53 → 78 with the layout fix. The frames also assert that no `not mocked` text is on screen, so a red banner cannot be read as part of the change.

## Why a test file this change does not touch appears in the diff

`services/api/src/research-package-http.test.ts` carries a defect that predates this PR: one case ("an over-cap export is refused…") installed **two** `context.mock.method(ResearchExportPreviews.prototype, "get", …)` calls on the same method in a single test. Restoring two wrappers of one method leaves the first one installed, so every later test in that file previewed at the earlier ceiling (`archiveBytes = maxBytes + 1`) and got a 413 on a fresh project. It was found while diagnosing this change's test, not introduced by it.

The fix is one mock whose value moves (`let sizedBytes`, reassigned for the second ceiling) instead of stacking two — no production cap was touched and no assertion accepts a 413 as expected. Isolated proof: the over-cap case plus this change's case run alone reproduces the 413; this change's case alone passes; the whole file after the fix is 32/32, three runs in a row.

Unrelated and left unattributed: while diagnosing, one full-file run also showed `the first-install sample supports all five preview profiles…` failing once. That run's failure text was overwritten before it could be read, so it is recorded here as **observed once, cause unknown** — not as the same defect and not as fixed.

## Tests

- `services/api/src/research-package-http.test.ts` — 32/32, full file, three consecutive runs.
- The new case: delete an artifact's CAS object → export (the manifest declares `cas:…:unavailable`) → import into a new Project → assert `continuationAvailable: true`, `continuationDowngraded: true`, `missingImmutableEvidence` **equal element by element** to what the package declared, the Session's snapshot agreeing with the receipt, and every declared omission still visible in the receipt or the copy's own preview afterwards.
- Mutation: reverting only `services/api/src/research-snapshots.ts` makes that case fail (`0 pass / 1 fail`, `AssertionError` on the downgrade flag), so the case is not passing on its own absence.
- `tsc --noEmit` clean for `@sciencediscovery/schema`, `@sciencediscovery/api`, `@sciencediscovery/desktop` and the root `tsconfig.tests.json`.

## Where this sits next to #1521

`#1521` was the first segment: an object the package points at but does not carry becomes an omission instead of a 404. This is the second segment: once an omission exists, how it is presented — allowed, downgraded, and named — up to the receipt and the desktop Session.

Closes #1532

1555.author: agent-ci-infra-bot[bot]
1555.body:
Step 6 of the mocked custom-MCP journey fails ~3 of 19 CI runs: the run completes with `MCP RECOVERED` while `GET /api/sessions/<id>/mcp/invocations` never gains the recovered call.

Root cause (not an early assertion: `broker.invoke` awaits the append; failing runs have no row): `mcpReadiness.decide("wait", …)` waited on the **blocked call's signal**: when that transport goes away mid-decision the signal aborts, the wait finishes `{action:"cancel"}` and the block is removed (the recheck then returns `409` mid-run); the catalog is never refreshed, `recoveredTools()` stays empty and `mcpReadiness.invoke` refuses the call before the broker.

Change (`artifact-manager/src/mcp-workspace-tools.ts`): the repair wait keeps its block for a bounded 10 s grace after the call signal aborts so an in-flight decision lands; a `retry` refreshes even when the transport is gone and re-observes once (without the call signal) when any affected source is still not `ready` (stale-revision snapshot, abort mid-discovery, or a non-empty catalog reporting the source in error); a failing discovery still surfaces; `cancel` never refreshes or invokes.

Validation: artifact-manager 29/29 (27/27 in the file; 20/27 pre-change); data-source 95/95; governance 26/26; services/api MCP+agent-run 333/333; typecheck, ci:selftest 243/243, check-e2e-meta 138 specs clean. Not run: `ci:ut`/`ci:e2e`/`ci:st` (no bubblewrap).

E2E (mocked journey, single worker): 16 runs finished, 12 passed, 3 failed at step 5; the step-6 invocation assertion ran in 13 with 0 failures (one later failed the message check); an earlier JiuwenSwarm batch finished 24 (8 passed), failing at step 2 `Error: terminated`, step 5 and step 6 (card). Host load was 12–37. Pre-change it failed 2 of 88 finished 4-worker runs (dev-reported) and 3 of 19 CI shards (9bf5077f7b, 87c5da950b, 127bb1fdef).

Risks: one-shot re-observation; a stopped run's card stays actionable ≤10 s; the CI transport trigger is unobserved.

Release: `release:fix`.

Closes #1034
